scope.selection: 旧快照 difficulty==7 且 examples 为空；冻结名单时当前 Android assets 仍为空；排除 tools/authored_content_v17_a.json；取前500词。

authorship: 500条英文例句及中文翻译逐词原创，未复制外部例句；无新增音标、派生词、同义词或事实性医疗指导。

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 弥补, 添字首音
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 假体；义肢，假肢
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 缺最常用医学义；“添字首音”属语言学专门义，不适合作主释义。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The technician adjusted the prosthesis to fit her leg more comfortably.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 继续的, 后果的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 按顺序的；连续的；相继的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: “继续的，后果的”不能准确表达 sequential 的顺序关系。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: Each folder has a sequential number to make it easier to locate.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 真菌, 突然发生而迅速生长的东西, 真菌类植物, 海绵肿, 真菌类病害
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 真菌的；由真菌引起的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 形容词被填入多项 fungus 名词义，含“真菌类植物”等错误表述。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The laboratory examined the sample for signs of fungal growth.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 韭
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 韭葱；大葱属的一种蔬菜
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 单写“韭”易与 chives 混淆；例句使用韭葱入汤。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: She sliced a leek and added it to the potato soup.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 玉蜀黍粉, 玉米片, 麦片
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 玉米粉；玉米面
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 删除不等价的“玉米片、麦片”；cornmeal 是研磨玉米得到的粉/粗粉。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: She dusted the baking tray with cornmeal before adding the dough.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 青葱( scallion的名词复数 ); 冬葱; 大葱; 韭菜
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 青葱；小葱（scallion 的复数）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 不应译为“韭菜”；可保留地区性大葱/冬葱用法。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: She sprinkled chopped scallions over the noodles.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 发现者, 寻星镜
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: n. 发现者；查找器；寻星镜
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有中文为名词，但词性标为 adj.；例句选发现者义。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The finder of the missing wallet handed it to the police.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 吸引
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: v. 吸引；引起（attract 的现在分词）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有词性错误地标为 n.；例句使用现在进行时。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The new exhibition is attracting visitors from nearby towns.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 没有；很少, 很小
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: interj. 不；不要；不了（非正式）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有 adj. 及“很少、很小”均不适用于本词常见用法。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: “Nah, I'm not hungry,” she said when he offered her a sandwich.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 孟诺教派；孟诺教派之教徒
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 阿米什派；阿米什派信徒；阿米什派的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有“孟诺教派”泛化错误，应明确 Amish 分支名称，增补形容词用法。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The exhibition includes quilts made by Amish craftspeople.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 冠的, 花冠的, 冠状的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 冠状动脉的；冠状的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 例句为 coronary arteries；花冠/冠形旧义可保留但不应掩盖医学常用义。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The diagram shows the coronary arteries around the heart.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 主任参谋, 副舰长
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 经理；主管；高管（executive 的非正式缩写）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有只列军舰副长相关职务；例句使用公司高管。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: A senior exec from the company attended the product launch.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: a. 两性的, 雌雄同体的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 双性恋的；双性恋者；两性的
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 应补人的性取向常见义，勿仅用雌雄同体解释。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The memoir describes her experience of coming out as bisexual.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 下层社会, 地狱, 下流社会
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 黑社会；犯罪集团；阴间
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: “下层社会/下流社会”不能准确代替犯罪世界；例句是 criminal underworld。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The novel follows a detective investigating the city's criminal underworld.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh:
n. 暂缓, 缓期执行
vt. 使暂缓
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 短暂的休息；喘息；暂缓
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有仅司法暂缓义；例句为暂避酷热的喘息机会。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The shade offered a brief respite from the afternoon heat.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 推磨的人, 研磨者
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 研磨机；磨碎器；磨工
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 缺器械义，例句为 coffee grinder。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: He adjusted the coffee grinder to produce a finer powder.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 装备, 衬托纸, 舞台效果, 上马
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: adj. 不断增加的；逐渐加剧的；n. 安装；底座
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有仅列名词装备/衬纸等，缺 mounting pressure 的常见形容词义。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: Mounting pressure from residents forced the council to reconsider the closure.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: v. 司炉, (使)大吃
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 给炉火添燃料；拨旺；煽动；激起
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: “司炉”不足以表达及物动词；例句为 stoke the fire。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: He added another log to stoke the fire.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 蛋奶糕
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 蛋奶酱；蛋奶冻；蛋奶糕
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 应补可流动的蛋奶酱，例句为浇在苹果派上的 custard。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: She spooned warm custard over a slice of apple pie.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: vt. 装配, 使成形
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 配置；设置；使成形
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 缺现代软件/设备配置义，例句为配置路由器。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The technician helped us configure the new router.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 用钩子的人, 渔船
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 橄榄球钩球队员；妓女（非正式，需用法标记）；用钩者；小渔船
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 例句采用橄榄球位置义；原有义项保留但缺常见现代词义。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The rugby team's hooker threw the ball into the lineout.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 普利策（美国新闻业经营者）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 普利策；普利策奖（Pulitzer Prize 的常用指称）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有仅人物说明；例句使用 Pulitzer Prize，建议关联专名短语而非只给人物。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The journalist's Pulitzer Prize was displayed beside her first newspaper article.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 硅树脂
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 硅酮；有机硅聚合物；硅胶（材料俗称）
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: “硅树脂”范围过窄；例句是柔性烘焙模具用有机硅材料。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The baker poured the batter into a flexible silicone mold.

meaningCorrectionsNeeded.oldMeaningZh: n. 地狱边缘, 监狱, 忘却
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.suggestedMeaningZh: 悬而未决的状态；被遗忘的境地；地狱边缘
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.reason: 现有无最常见 in limbo 义；例句为申请因职责争议而悬而未决。
meaningCorrectionsNeeded.exampleEn: The application remained in limbo while the two offices disputed responsibility.
